# Validation Tests

! exec akb init foo/bar
stderr 'must not contain'

! exec akb init -- -test
stderr 'must not start'

! exec akb status
stderr 'no default KB set'

exec akb init mykb
! exec akb init mykb
stderr 'already initialized'

exec akb status
stdout 'Name: mykb'

exec akb --version
stdout 'akb'
